name: wc-grid-table
description: A table component implemented with css-grid and webcomponents.

scripts.copy_public: copyfiles -f src/public/* dist && copyfiles -f src/example1/* dist/example1 && copyfiles -f src/example2/* dist/example2 && copyfiles -f src/standalone/* dist/standalone
scripts.build:standalone:min: browserify -p tinyify -t browserify-css src/wc-grid-table.js --standalone WcGridTable > dist/standalone/bundle.min.js
scripts.build:all: npm run setup_folder && npm run build && npm run build:min && npm run build:standalone && npm run build:standalone:min && npm run build:example1 && npm run build:example1:min && npm run copy_public
scripts.publish:patch: npm run build:all && git add * && git commit && npm version patch && git push && npm publish && git push --tags
scripts.publish:minor: npm run build:all && git add * && git commit && npm version minor && git push && npm publish && git push --tags
scripts.publish:major: npm run build:all && git add * && git commit && npm version major && git push && npm publish && git push --tags

author: Robert Seidler
